what: Proposed Codex auth temp home lacks a cleanup contract
scenario_or_breakage: The plan adds a temp CODEX_HOME in the negotiation Codex branch, and external_prepare_codex_auth may leave a copied config plus auth.json symlink there; without an EXIT cleanup this auth material can remain after success or failure
suggested_fix: Add a branch-local cleanup trap or explicit cleanup that removes the temp CODEX_HOME on every codex-branch exit path
